population.women: Age 18-40 inclusive, pregnant women excluded (v213==1). Final N=434,502 usable Target A rows.
population.men: Age 18-40 inclusive. mv213 (partner pregnancy) explicitly NOT used for exclusion. Final N=56,092 usable Target A rows.

target_definition.name: Target A (locked, research-defined)
target_definition.positive_rule: K OR (valid glucose AND glucose>=200 mg/dL)
target_definition.negative_rule: all three flags explicitly No AND valid glucose AND glucose<=140 mg/dL
target_definition.excluded: no valid glucose + no known flag; glucose 141-199 + no known flag; any flag blank/dont-know rather than explicit No
target_definition.validated_against: women POS=13839 NEG=420663 (post-pregnancy-exclusion), exact match to locked benchmark

train_test_split.seed_selection: deterministic search from seed=42 upward until train/test target prevalence within +/-15% relative tolerance; seed=42 satisfied on first try for both sexes
train_test_split.psu_disjointness: verified zero overlap between train/test PSUs for both sexes

model_comparison: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting compared via grouped CV (ROC-AUC, PR-AUC primary; RF excluded from further stages - weakest on both metrics for both sexes)

calibration.method_selection: sigmoid vs isotonic compared via nested grouped 5-fold CV on OOF predictions only; isotonic won for women, sigmoid won for men

thresholds_LOCKED.selection_rule: Highest threshold (0.001-step grid) on the calibrated grouped-OOF training predictions whose sensitivity is still >= 0.75. A documented SCREENING-THRESHOLD CHOICE reflecting a sensitivity/specificity trade-off, not a clinically optimal or universally correct threshold.
thresholds_LOCKED.single_source_of_truth: the 'selected_threshold' stored in models/{women,men}_production_pipeline.pkl; configs/config.py DOCUMENTED_THRESHOLDS and this manifest mirror it and tests assert they agree
thresholds_LOCKED.provenance_note: The threshold is a decision rule applied to calibrated probabilities; it does not enter model or calibrator fitting. The fitted model and calibrator objects are unchanged, and the stored threshold value was set to the locked value after the threshold-review stage. src/models/final_refit.py now reads the locked value from configs/config.py.

final_test_evaluation.note: Test sets evaluated exactly once, after model/calibration/threshold were fully locked using training/OOF data only.

known_environment_limitations: SHAP package unavailable (no network access in this session) - permutation importance used as a documented, clearly-labeled substitute for global feature importance, NOT presented as SHAP
pandas pure-Python Stata reader (not pyreadstat) required chunked reading for the large women raw file due to container memory limits - raw data no longer present in this project (never committed)

pipeline_stages_in_order.purpose: raw NFHS-5 .DTA -> slim interim datasets (only the required variables); see docs/DATA_REPRODUCTION.md
Target A + exclusion_reason_final (validated to locked benchmark counts)
predictor matrices (pregnancy exclusion applied; BP/BMI/duration recodes)
calibrated-OOF threshold tables; final rule = highest 0.001-grid threshold with sensitivity >= 0.75 (reproduces 0.026 / 0.027)
refit on full training data; save production pipeline with the locked thresholds (read from configs/config.py)
single evaluation on untouched test sets
permutation importance (NOT SHAP) + LR reference coefficients, computed on training data

pipeline_scripts_note: Scripts are the as-run pipeline with paths resolved through configs/config.py. Re-running them requires the licensed NFHS-5 raw files in data/raw/ (not distributed) and regenerates data/interim/ and data/processed/. The frozen results live in models/, configs/ and reports/; those files, not a re-run, are the record of the locked results.
